source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The landing removes the messenger window-service interface, component registrations and implementation, and deletes the NewChannel branch that selected an IMAP folder then dispatched to that service. HandleContent now rejects content with NS_ERROR_WONT_HANDLE_CONTENT. The removed code was a reachable folder-URL behavior; the historical broken-for-years claim does not establish that it was dead. The fixed accepted handler still rejects content, while NewChannel has later changes. No live URL, command-line or window test was run.
title: The IMAP folder-URL window-opening service is removed with its content-handler path
